camel_example: aliyun linkwan CountNotifications --region cn-hangzhou --EndMillis 1514736000000 --Category.1 GATEWAY_OFFLINE --HandleState UNHANDLED --BeginMillis 1514736000000 --version 2019-03-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Counts the number of notifications that meet the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 调用CountNotifications统计符合过滤条件的通知数量
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan count-notifications --category GATEWAY_OFFLINE --handle-state UNHANDLED --begin-millis 1514736000000 --end-millis 1514736000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CountNotifications

parameters.help_en:
The list of notification types. If null is specified, the notification type is not filtered. Valid values:

GATEWAY_OFFLINE: Gateway offline information.

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING: Join permission authorization in progress.

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED: Join permission authorization succeeded.

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED: Join permission authorization canceled.

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED: Join permission authorization rejected
parameters.help_zh:
通知类型列表，传null值则不过滤类型。

GATEWAY_OFFLINE：网关离线信息。

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING：凭证授权中。

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED：凭证授权成功。

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED：撤销凭证授权。

JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED：拒绝凭证授权
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: Filters notifications by processing status. If null is specified, the processing status is not filtered
parameters.help_zh: 根据通知处理状态过滤，传null值则不过滤处理状态
parameters.name: handle_state

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
